title: deguelia rufescens
intro: Deguelia rufescens, commonly known as the Red Deguelia, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Deguelia rufescens include its ability to inhibit the growth of pathogens and reduce inflammation, as well as its potential to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
